name: 边缘一致性分析
description: 分析 edge sharpness 梯度s using Sobel operators. AI生成的 images often have abnormally smooth or uniform edge transitions compared to natural photos.
mechanism: It mercilessly dissects the width and contrast-transition gradient operating exclusively along the jawline, shoulders, or clothing silhouette. Authentic physics mandate that organic optical borders harbor immense micro-diffraction overlap where objects meet the background. Lazy fraudsters wielding the Lasso/Magic Wand tool impart a razor-sharp, blade-like mathematical cut completely devoid of organic depth... The engine merely has to detect the absence of microscopic chromatic aberration along the splice to trigger an execution alarm.
parameters: Sobel kernel: 3x3, Edge 阈值: 自适应 Otsu, Metrics: edge density, 连贯性 ratio
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80% as a supporting signal
useCase: Supplementary 检测 of AI-typical edge uniformity 模式

references.title: Canny, J. (1986). A Computational Approach to Edge Detection. IEEE TPAMI.
Chai, L. et al. (2020). What Makes Fake Images Detectable? ECCV.

strengths:
• 快速高效的分析
• 良好检测异常边缘均匀性
• 频率方法的良好补充
• 适用于多种内容类型
limitations:
• 微距或浅景深图像可能产生误报
• 经过锐化/模糊处理的图像效果降低
• 无法区分AI和CGI
